intro: Gabon earns money from oil, manganese and timber.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Oil, manganese (Gabon is a top producer) and timber are major exports. Gabon is one of the richer countries in Africa per person, though many people are poor.

chapters.title: Ecotourism
text: Gabon hopes wildlife tourism will grow.

keyTerms.meaning: A metal used to make steel.

cardGroups.title: Made in Gabon
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Gabon makes and sells to the world.
